name: @avatark/canonical-event-runtime
description: Executes Sprint 18's canonical-event integration: pure eligibility evaluation against already-authoritative world facts, a deterministic ACTIVATED-once state transition, and content-derived activation identity. scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json --outDir dist --declaration --noEmit false --rewriteRelativeImportExtensions --module esnext --moduleResolution bundler && node ../../scripts/fix-dts-extensions.mjs dist
